summary: A short note from Alex McKenzie at BBN that attaches network traffic statistics for the ARPANET for August 1972. The tables show how many packets each host sent over the period. It updates RFC 378. BBN had been giving these figures to ARPA each month and now shared them with the whole network community.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 391 presents ARPANET traffic statistics for August 1972 by site and host. Its final rows give network totals and daily averages for inter-node and intra-node traffic.

subtitle: A table of ARPANET traffic statistics for August 1972.

tldr.problem: Readers needed a summary of how much ARPANET traffic each site and host handled during August 1972.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC lists inter-node and intra-node traffic, totals, average daily inter-node traffic, and the number of days for each site or host.
tldr.outcome: The table reports 21,157,570 inter-node and 8,926,549 intra-node units and updates RFC 378.

sections.title: Statistics for August 1972
sections.content:
RFC 391 is a short note by Alex McKenzie dated September 15, 1972. It attaches network traffic statistics for August 1972 and updates RFC 378.

The document consists mainly of tables rather than protocol requirements.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a measurement report, not a protocol definition. It records network traffic for one month.

sections.title: Reading the Site and Host Rows
sections.content:
The table lists sites and their hosts. Its columns show inter-node traffic, intra-node traffic, total traffic, average daily inter-node traffic, and days in the reporting period.

Sites with multiple hosts have subtotal rows. The report also marks TINK, MC CL, and BELV as having no traffic during the period.
sections.plainLanguage: Each row shows traffic for a host or a site's subtotal. The columns separate traffic between nodes from traffic within a node.

sections.title: Network Totals
sections.content:
The final lines report totals of 21,157,570 inter-node and 8,926,549 intra-node. The daily averages are 682,502 inter-node and 287,953 intra-node.

The table also lists averages per node-day of 23,535 and 9,929, and a packets/messages (internode) value of 1.09.
sections.plainLanguage: The bottom of the table adds the reported traffic across the network and gives daily averages. It also lists the average packets per internode message.
